rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The two arbiters are Muslims, who judge the proper equivalent for the game animal killed in consecration.
rows.anchor: ذوا عدل منكم } أي المسلمين

rows.speaker: الشافعي
rows.claim: Al-Shafiʿi divides game animals with an equivalent into cases adjudicated by the Companions and cases without a Companion ruling; their decisions bind because they witnessed revelation and interpretation.
rows.anchor: وعن الشافعي أن الذي له مثل ضربان : ما حكمت فيه الصحابة

rows.speaker: الشافعي
rows.claim: For an animal without a Companion ruling, two just arbiters use independent judgment, compare it with the three livestock kinds, and require the closest match.
rows.anchor: وما لم يحكموا به يرجع فيه إلى اجتهاد عدلين , فينظر إلى الأجناس الثلاثة من الأنعام

rows.speaker: الشافعي
rows.claim: Al-Shafiʿi allows an accidental killer to serve as one of the arbiters, but bars a deliberate killer because deliberate killing makes him morally corrupt.
rows.anchor: فإن كان القتل خطأ جاز أن يكون الفاعل أحد الحكمين , وإن كان عمدا فلا , لأنه يفسق به

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The required offering is brought to Mecca as an act of honor and ritual, then slaughtered there and given to the sanctuary's poor.
rows.anchor: ولما كان هذا المثل يساق إلى مكة المشرفة على وجه الإكرام والنسك رفقا بمساكينها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: “Reaching the Kaaba” means reaching its associated sanctuary; naming the Kaaba magnifies it and identifies it as the intended destination for visitation and upkeep.
rows.anchor: بالغ الكعبة } أي الحرم المنسوب إليها , وإنما صرح بها زيادة في التعظيم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The genitive construction is lexical because the descriptive form resembles a verb, which is why it can describe an indefinite noun.
rows.anchor: والإضافة لفظية لأن الوصف بشبه ( يبلغ ) فلذا وصف بها النكرة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The expiation offers a choice: feed sanctuary poor food equal in value to the offering, one mudd for each poor person, or fast one day for each mudd anywhere.
rows.anchor: كفارة } هي { طعام مساكين } في الحرم بمقدار قيمة الهدي , لكل مسكين مد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: “Or” ordinarily marks a choice here; treating the options as sequential would require evidence.
rows.anchor: فأو للتخيير لأنه الأصل فيها , والقول بأنها للترتيب يحتاج إلى دليل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The penalty lets the intentional killer feel the burden and bad consequence of his act, deterring repetition.
rows.anchor: أي فعليه أن يجازي بما ينقص المال أو يؤلم الجسم { ليذوق وبال } أي ثقل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Although the verse addresses deliberate killing, the ruling also covers accidental killing so deliberate offenders cannot falsely claim a mistake, protecting the sanctity of religion and law.
rows.anchor: طرد الحكم في غير المتعمد لئلا يدعي المتعمد أنه مخطئ , كل ذلك حمى لحرمة الدين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God pardons deliberate game killing that occurred before this ruling was revealed.
rows.anchor: عما سلف } أي تعمده , أي لكم من ذلك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Anyone who again deliberately kills any amount, however small, incurs God's just punishment for returning to the offense.
rows.anchor: ومن عاد } إلى تعمد شيء من ذلك ولو قل ؛ ولما كان المبتدأ متضمنا معنى الشرط

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The offender violates both consecration and the sanctuary; God is unconquerable and takes retribution from those who defy His command.
rows.anchor: منتهكا لحرمة الإحرام والحرم , وكان التقدير : فالله قادر عليه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Because the deniers dismiss revelation as tales, Muhammad is told to have them travel and inspect the fate of earlier peoples, including the peoples of Salih, Lot, and Shuʿayb.
rows.anchor: أن يأمرهم بأن يشاهدوا مصارع من تمكن في قلوبهم علم أنهم أهلكوا بمثل تكذيبهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Travel is for taking a lesson and not being deceived by respite; the command recalls the earlier question about seeing how many God destroyed.
rows.anchor: قل سيروا } أي أوقعوا السير للاعتبار ولا تغتروا بإمهالكم وتمكينكم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The journey and inspection serve as evidence for the earlier warning that disbelievers would call the message manifest magic.
rows.anchor: وهي كالدليل على قوله تعالى : ^ ( { لقال الذين كفروا إن هذا إلا سحر مبين } ) ^

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The pause before inspection strengthens the threat, displays God's power, and is fairer to the deniers; the early surah's place among early revelations reinforces the delay.
rows.anchor: أمهلهم في النظر فإنه أقوى في التهديد , وأدل على القدرة , وأدعى إلى النصفة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: People should reflect at length on the fate of those destroyed for rejecting messengers, since the traces make the lesson increasingly clear.
rows.anchor: أنعموا النر وبالغوا في التفكر وأطيلوا التدبر إذا رأيتم آثار المعذبين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Asking who owns the heavens and earth recalls God's benefits and rebukes people for enjoying His provision while worshipping others like themselves or less.
rows.anchor: تقبيحا لأن يأكلوا خيره ويعبدوا غيره

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The question establishes the Creator, prophethood, and resurrection; fronting its object emphasizes the one to be worshipped.
rows.anchor: فقال مقررا لهم على إثبات الصانع والنبوة والمعاد , ومبكتا بسفههم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God answers the question Himself rather than waiting for the obstinate audience, rebuking their claimed fairness.
rows.anchor: أشار إلى ذلك بقوله معرضا عن انتظار جوابهم توبيخا لهم بعدم النصفة التي يدعونها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The answer is God alone, whom no peer equals; even hostile hearers cannot deny it because the created and contingent character of the universe is evident.
rows.anchor: قل الله } أي الذي له الإحاطة الكاملة قدرة وعلما ولا كفوء له , لا لغيره

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The world's many good, pleasant benefits, with its harms largely concealed, are signs of God's oneness, knowledge, and power, and display mercy preceding wrath.
rows.anchor: والكل مع ذلك دلائل ظاهرة على وحدانيته وتمام علمه وقدرته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's writing mercy upon Himself is either a promise fixed like something sealed in writing or a decree He writes as He wills; “self” refers to the divine essence.
rows.anchor: كتب } أي وعد وعدا هو كالمكتوب الذي ختم , وأكد غاية التأكيد , أو كتب حيث أراد سبحانه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: This mercy appears in lavish blessings and in postponing annihilating punishment despite people's sin and hostility.
rows.anchor: فلذلك أكرمكم هذا الإكرام بوجوه الإنعام , وأخر عنكم الانتقام بالاستئصال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The first creation proves resurrection: the world's contingent properties were assigned by a choosing agent capable of all possibilities and knowing all things.
rows.anchor: اختصاص كل جسم بصفته المعينة إنما يكون بتخصيص الفاعل المختار , فيكون قادرا على الإعادة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God gathers everyone for justice on the Day of Resurrection, where mercy is reserved for His allies and punishment for His enemies, completing the mercy distributed to all in worldly life.
rows.anchor: لتخصيص الرحمة في ذلك اليوم بأوليائه والمقت والنقمة بأعدائه بعد أن كان عم بالرحمة الفريقين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The resurrection is certain because God's messengers announced it and creation's wise design points to it; judgment supplies the just order otherwise absent from much animal life and earlier ignorance.
rows.anchor: لإخبار الله به على ألسنة رسله ولما عليه من الأدلة لما في هذا الخلق من بدائع الحكم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those who reject resurrection destroy themselves by resisting innate disposition and sound reason, neglecting reason and relying on senses and imitation; disbelief reflects their loss, not a lack of proof.
rows.anchor: الذين خسروا أنفسهم } أي بإهلاكهم إياها بتكذيبهم به لمخالفة الفطرة الأولى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Everything located in night and day belongs to God; the wording includes what may dwell there even while moving and includes light and darkness implicated in false worship.
rows.anchor: ما من شأنه أن يسكن فيهما وإن كان متحركا , ولكنه عبر بذلك دون التحرك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's complete hearing and knowledge encompass every moving and still thing and all words and deeds, so nothing escapes recompense; “knowing” is more comprehensive than “seeing.”
rows.anchor: العام العلم بالبصر والسمع وغيرهما بكل متحرك وبكل ساكن من أقوالكم وأفعالكم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The description of God as All-Hearing, All-Knowing translates the teaching that He knows people's secrets, public words, and deeds, and recalls the same description in the rebuke against worshipping powerless beings.
rows.anchor: وهو ترجمة قوله : 77 ( { يعلم سركم وجهركم ويعلم ما تكسبون } ) 77

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: After establishing divine oneness, the passage reminds the audience that supplication may remove affliction and warns that abandoning it brings misery.
rows.anchor: أخبرهم أن تركه يوجب الشقاء , ترغيبا في إدامته وترهيبا من مجانبته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God sent messengers to selected earlier communities whose stories He intended to display; the word for communities denotes people who follow one another and are worth visiting for their number and stature.
rows.anchor: إلى أمم } أي أناس يؤم بعضهم بعضا , وهم أهل لأن يقصدهم الناس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The sending of messengers was followed by God's seizure of their rejecting communities to turn them from Satan's embellishments toward the messengers' call.
rows.anchor: فأخذناهم } أي فكان إرسالنا إليهم سببا لأن أخذناهم بعظمتنا , ليرجعوا عما زين لهم الشيطان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The afflictions comprised killing, poverty, and illness, intended to make the communities humble themselves intensely in supplication.
rows.anchor: بالبأساء } من تسليط القتل عليهم { والضراء } بتسليط الفقر والأوجاع

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The emphatic form conveys deep humility; because this surah argues for divine oneness, supplication should be stressed when laying foundations, unlike the treatment in al-Aʿraf.
rows.anchor: مع صيغة التفعيل - الإظهار , ولأن مقصودها الاستدلال على التوحيد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The restriction in the rebuke shows the communities had no excuse for failing to supplicate when God's punishment reached them.
rows.anchor: فقال معبرا بأداة التخصيص ليفيد مع النفي أنهم ما كان لهم عذر في ترك التضرع

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The earlier communities did not humble themselves; their hearts hardened so they failed to remember God, while Satan made their grave wrongdoing attractive through their desires.
rows.anchor: ولكن قست قلوبهم } أي فلم يذكروا ربهم أصلا { وزين لهم الشيطان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: When they neglected the warning and its intended humility, God opened every door of prosperity, provision, and pleasure to them as gradual enticement and prolonged that period.
rows.anchor: فتحنا } أي بما يليق بعظمتنا { عليهم أبواب كل شيء } أي من الخيرات والأرزاق والملاد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They became excessively pleased with their gifts, turned away from the giver, and wrongly treated hardship as mere fortune and prosperity as their due, showing that neither trial nor blessing could awaken them.
rows.anchor: فعلم أنهم في غاية من الغباوة , لا يرتدعون بالتأديب بسياط البلاء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God seized them suddenly while they enjoyed prosperity, making the sorrow more severe and leaving no time to supplicate or prepare for overwhelming punishment.
rows.anchor: أخذناهم في حال الرخاء ليكون أشد لتحسرهم { بغتة } فلم نمكنهم من التضرع

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They were left stunned, despairing, regretful, and bewildered; their silence persisted until they died and fell quiet.
rows.anchor: فإذا هم مبلسون * } أي تسبب عن ذلك البغت أن فاجؤوا السكوت على ما في أنفسهم واليأس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Denying supplication to earlier peoples, after affirming it for this community's polytheists, gently appeals to the present audience; the earlier people's prosperity was deliberate enticement before sudden chastisement.
rows.anchor: ففي نفي التضرع عن المتقدمين بعد أن أثبته لمشركي هذه الأمة استعطاف لطيف

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Unlike ordinary armies that leave their rear behind, God's seizure reaches the last of a people as fully as the first; the passive wording and “rear” signify complete power and eradication.
rows.anchor: أخبر تعالى أن أخذه على غير ذلك , وأن نيله للآخر كنيله للأول على حد سواء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The wrongdoers misplaced their response like someone walking in darkness: they hardened where hardship should have softened them and rejoiced at blessings instead of fearing a return to distress.
rows.anchor: بوضع الشيء في غير موضعه دأب الماشي في الظلام , وضعوا لقسوة موضع الرقة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The audience repeated the same error by invoking idols in ease, when they should call on the giver of blessings, and calling on God in distress instead of those they worshipped in ease.
rows.anchor: كما ظلمتم أنتم بدعاء الأصنام وقت الرخاء وكان ذلك موضع دعاء من أفاض تلك النعم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The destruction of the enemies of the messengers and their followers is a blessing to them and displays God's absolute independence.
rows.anchor: من أجل النعم على من عادوهم فيه من الرسل عليهم السلام وأتباعهم رضي الله عنهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God alone possesses perfection and remains praised after creation perishes, just as before it existed; creatures neither increase nor diminish His perfection.
rows.anchor: فهو محمود حال الإعدام والمحق كما كان محمودا حال الإيجاد والخلق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: This conclusion echoes the surah's opening: God created the heavens and earth and made darkness and light, while disbelievers still equate others with Him.
rows.anchor: الذي خلق السماوات والأرض وجعل الظلمات والنور , ثم الذين كفروا بربهم يعدلون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Prophet need not grieve over them, since their belief or unbelief does not escape God's will.
rows.anchor: فلا تذهب نفسك عليهم حسرات , فإنه لا يخرج شيء عن إيمانهم ولا كفرانهم عن إرادته سبحانه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their demands for signs do not burden the Prophet; his responsibility is only to deliver the message.
rows.anchor: فلا عليك منهم اقترحوا الآيات أولا , فإنه ليس عليك إلا البلاغ

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: No entity besides God, including the idols people claim are intercessors, can protect against Him; therefore all such beings plainly lack power to benefit or harm.
rows.anchor: أن غير الله لا يمنع من الله بنوع , لا آلهتهم التي زعموا أنها شفعاؤهم ولا غيرها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The question rebukes them for worshipping other than the One who alone controls everything and for treating powerless objects as objects of devotion.
rows.anchor: منكرا عليهم موبخا لهم { أندعوا } أي دعاء عبادة , وبين حقارة معبوداتهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The surrounding reminders of God's creative and protective blessings explain why benefit is mentioned before harm in the claim that idols cannot do either.
rows.anchor: ولما كان السياق لتعداد النعم ^ ( { الذي خلق السماوات والأرض } ) ^

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The argument supports the earlier declaration that the Prophet was forbidden to worship the beings his audience invokes besides God.
rows.anchor: وهذا كالتعليل لقوله 77 ( { إني نهيت أن أعبد الذين تدعون من دون الله } ) 77

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Returning to shirk is expressed passively because the reversal itself is objectionable, whoever might bring it about.
rows.anchor: وبناه للمفعول لأن المنكر الرد نفسه من أي راد كان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Going back on one's heels means taking the direction opposite the intended goal and continually losing distance from it; God had guided and rescued them from shirk.
rows.anchor: فنأخذ في الوجه المخالف لقصدنا فنصير كل وقت في خسارة بالبعد عن المقصود

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The lost person is likened to someone devils have drawn from a high rank into a dark, dangerous abyss, disoriented and blind to escape.
rows.anchor: شبه حاله بحال من سقط من عال في مهواة مظلمة فهو في حال هويه في غاية الاضطراب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Although the lost person has several companions urging him to return to guidance, confusion keeps him from accepting their sincere call to come to them.
rows.anchor: له } أي هذا الذي هوى { أصحاب } أي عدة , ولكنه لتمكن الحيرة منه لا يقبل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The familiar example shows that the companions' sincere guidance would save him, whereas following devils leaves him in irretrievable ruin.
rows.anchor: وكانوا عالمين بأن دعاء أصحابه له في غاية النصيحة والخير , وأنه إن تبعهم نجا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Only God's guidance is true guidance; the companions' direction is negligible beside it because only God's path leads to everlasting happiness.
rows.anchor: قل إن هدى الله } أي المستجمع لصفات الكمال { هو } أي خاصة { الهدى } أي لا غيره

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Believers are commanded to obey God's will completely and set aside their own desires, while performing prayer with all its outward and inward requirements.
rows.anchor: لأن نسلم بأن نوقع الإسلام وهو الانقياد التام فنتخلى عن كل هوى , وأن نقيم الصلاة بأن نوقعها بجميع حدودها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They surrender and pray for the Lord of all worlds, who has shown beneficence to everyone; piety means performing prayer in reverent watchfulness rather than mockery or play.
rows.anchor: لرب العالمين * } أي لإحسانه إلى كل أحد بكل شيء خلقه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The one who first created people from clay and spread them through life will gather them after resurrection; the preceding proofs establish His power to do so.
rows.anchor: فهو الذي ابتدأ خلقكم من طين فإذا أنتم بشر مصورون , وجعلكم أحياء فبقدرته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The gathering is to God alone, where no one else has a say and worldly bonds and mutual support no longer operate; this also grounds the command to be wary of Him.
rows.anchor: لأنه لا كلام هناك لسواه , فلا علق بين المحشورين ولا تناصر كما في الدنيا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The passage uses ellipsis by mentioning prayer in the second command to supply its omission in the first, and mentioning Islam in the first to supply its omission in the second.
rows.anchor: والجملة مع ذلك كالتعليل للأمر بالتقوى , وقد بان أن الآية من الاحتباك
